prompt: A black-and-white hand-lettering quote poster in portrait format, flat vector artwork on a solid black background. Five lines of white lettering are stacked in one tight block in the center of the poster, with wide empty black margins around it, and the whole block tilts slightly so each line rises toward the right. At the top, the word "KINDNESS" is written in huge heavy condensed bold sans-serif capitals. Directly beneath it, the word "Stays" is written in large bold flowing brush script with a big looping initial capital. In the middle of the block sits a small solid white rectangular label, and inside that label the word "AFTER" is printed in small bold black sans-serif capitals, with three short white sparkle strokes placed outside the label, one group on its left and one group on its right. Below the label, the word "Words" is written in the same bold brush script. At the bottom, the word "FADE" is written in the same heavy condensed sans-serif capitals as the top line, and it is the largest line of all. The lines touch and slightly overlap. The poster shows only these five words, each of them once, in pure white and black with no gray, no shadow, no texture, and nothing below the last line.
